intro.fr: RWBY: Grimm Eclipse se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: RWBY: Grimm Eclipse can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Rooster Teeth Games sort RWBY: Grimm Eclipse en 2016.
text.en: Rooster Teeth Games releases RWBY: Grimm Eclipse in 2016.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub nepcore/RwbyAP, qui héberge l'APWorld de RWBY: Grimm Eclipse.
text.en: The GitHub repository nepcore/RwbyAP, home of the RWBY: Grimm Eclipse APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.2.3, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (6 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.2.3 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (6 versions released).

text.fr: RWBY: Grimm Eclipse figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: RWBY: Grimm Eclipse is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
